Goin' Down The Road Feelin' Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Smokestack Lightning** (1 review, 1 other source): Garcia was smiling at Los Lobos' bass player, who watched the band play this number; Several FOB tapers, including the uploader's group, were shut down during this song [4][7]
- **Let The Good Times Roll** (1 review): The opener gets the groove off to a keen start [14]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): Played in a subdued but unified manner [14]
- **New Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Reviewer says it revives the energy of the first set [14]
- **Don't Ease Me In** (1 review): Closes the first set, but this particular download lacks the track [12]

## The recordings

- **gd88-07-30.sbd-aud.goetz.19585.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 163 min; rated 1/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: This matrix source is much weaker than the FOB source and doesn't serve the show well [10]
- **gd88-07-30.nak700-reutelhuber.miller.21092.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 171 min; rated 3.83/5 by 24 [2]. Said about its sound: This recording is far worse than the FOB source; reviewer recommends downloading that one instead; Reviewer finds this recording pretty good in quality, comparable to the 29th [11][16]
- **gd1988-07-30.beyer.connor.82207.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 158 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd1988-07-30.fob.nak100.holtz.jaz.102904.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 166 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Hot weather; the reviewer sold cold beer to fans walking uphill from the car valley, and remembers tent city [8]
- Reviewer recalls Garcia smiling often and an eccentric dancer standing nearby [9]
- Los Lobos and David Linley opened all three Laguna Seca shows [16]
- Mornings were foggy, sun broke through near midday, and shows ran from mid afternoon into the night [16]
- Arriving after the first night, the reviewer walked about a mile and a half to Shakedown, hearing praise for the previous night's China>Fingers>Rider [17]
- Reviewer considers it a solid, underrated show among the 1988 performances [10]
- Reviewer considers it a solid, underrated show among the 1988 performances [11]
- The band plays a number of older rock numbers in this show [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd88-07-30.sbd-aud.goetz.19585.sbeok.shnf**: source: 1st set sbd matrix>unknown cassette generations>?dat?>cdr>wav>shn ; 2nd set aud(unknown taper)>unknown cassette generations>?dat?>cdr>wav>shn; [1]. Also: Shorten files converted with MKW by Robert Goetz [1]
- **gd88-07-30.nak700-reutelhuber.miller.21092.sbeok.shnf**: source: Recording Info:(FOB/Split 10 to 20 Feet)Nakamichi CM700/CP701 -> dbx type II encoder -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M) [2]
- **gd1988-07-30.beyer.connor.82207.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Charlie Connor; transferred by Charlie Connor; source: FOB>Beyer Dynamic M88's>Sony TCD5M (CM - TDK MA90's) [4]. Also: Bill Reutelhuber used Nakamichi CM700/CP701 mics, a dbx type II encoder and a Sony TC-D5M cassette deck; Charlie Connor taped and transferred this version, patching a secondary source from 4:03 of d3t02 to the end [4]
- **gd1988-07-30.fob.nak100.holtz.jaz.102904.flac16**: taped by Greg Holtz; transferred by JAZ; source: Nakamichi CM-100 mics with CP-1 caps (In Hat FOB) Sony WM-D6 [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Kirsten Michel: [1988-07-31 Laguna Seca Recreation Area, Monterey, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1988-07-31-laguna-seca-recreation-area-monterey-ca-usa/) [20]
- Poster by Kirsten Michel: [1988-07-29 Laguna Seca Recreation Area, Monterey, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1988-07-29-laguna-seca-recreation-area-monterey-ca-usa/) [21]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Laguna Seca Recreation Area - July 31, 1988](https://www.dead.net/show/july-31-1988) [22]
- Photo by zoooma (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 7/30/88 Laguna Seca Recreation Area, Salin… | Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/photos/zoooma/3755497757/) [23]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/zoooma/3755497757/) [24]
